scripts.dev:stack: docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose.dev.yml run --build --rm migrate && docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose.dev.yml up --build -d api worker web proxy
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @anar/domain build && pnpm --filter @anar/db build && pnpm -r typecheck && tsc -p packages/domain/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @anar/domain build && pnpm --filter @anar/db build && pnpm --filter @anar/api build && pnpm --filter @anar/worker build && node scripts/check-web-units.ts && pnpm --filter @anar/web test lib/errors.test.ts && pnpm --filter @anar/domain test && pnpm --filter @anar/api test && pnpm --filter @anar/worker test && node --test scripts/*.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: pnpm --filter @anar/domain build && pnpm --filter @anar/db build && pnpm --filter @anar/api build && pnpm --filter @anar/worker build && pnpm --filter @anar/db test:integration && pnpm --filter @anar/worker test:integration
scripts.e2e: pnpm --filter @anar/domain build && node scripts/check-e2e.ts && pnpm --filter @anar/web e2e
